title: F1 Live Configuration
description: F1 Live (fork of f1-scoreboard). Live OpenF1 race timing, standings, race results, qualifying, practice, sprint, upcoming races, and calendar.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable or disable the F1 scoreboard plugin

display_duration.title: Display Duration
display_duration.description: Duration in seconds for the display controller to show each plugin mode before rotating

update_interval.title: Update Interval
update_interval.description: How often to fetch new data from APIs in seconds

favorite_team.title: Favorite Team
favorite_team.description: Favorite constructor/team ID (e.g., mclaren, ferrari, red_bull, mercedes, williams, aston_martin, alpine, haas, sauber, rb). This team will always be shown and highlighted in standings.

favorite_driver.title: Favorite Driver
favorite_driver.description: Favorite driver code (e.g., VER, NOR, PIA, LEC, SAI, HAM, RUS, ALO, STR). This driver will always be shown and highlighted in standings and results.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to display event start times (e.g. America/Chicago). Leave blank to follow the LEDMatrix global timezone, or the system timezone if none is set.

driver_standings.title: Driver Standings
driver_standings.description: Configuration for current driver championship standings

top_n.title: Top Drivers
top_n.description: Number of top drivers to show in standings

always_show_favorite.title: Always Show Favorite
always_show_favorite.description: Always include favorite driver even if outside top N

constructor_standings.title: Constructor Standings
constructor_standings.description: Configuration for current constructor championship standings

top_n.title: Top Constructors
top_n.description: Number of top constructors to show

always_show_favorite.title: Always Show Favorite
always_show_favorite.description: Always include favorite team even if outside top N

show_driver_split.title: Show Driver Points Split
show_driver_split.description: Show each constructor's two drivers and their individual point contributions (e.g. NOR 189 | PIA 145)

recent_races.title: Recent Race Results
recent_races.description: Configuration for recent Grand Prix results

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show recent race results display mode

number_of_races.title: Number of Races
number_of_races.description: Number of recent races to show

top_finishers.title: Top Finishers
top_finishers.description: Number of top finishers to display per race

always_show_favorite.title: Always Show Favorite
always_show_favorite.description: Always include favorite driver in results even if outside top N finishers

show_position_delta.title: Show Position Delta
show_position_delta.description: Show positions gained (+N green) or lost (-N red) compared to grid starting position

show_dnf_status.title: Show DNF/Retirement
show_dnf_status.description: Show RET for retired drivers or +NL for lapped drivers instead of gap time

show_points_haul.title: Show Points Haul Card
show_points_haul.description: Show a bar-chart card after each race result displaying championship points scored per driver

points_haul_drivers.title: Points Haul Drivers
points_haul_drivers.description: Number of point-scoring drivers to show on the points haul bar chart (max 10 drivers score in F1)

show_winners_summary.title: Show Winners Summary Card
show_winners_summary.description: Show a compact summary card listing the winner of each recent race (team accent color, race name, winner code)

show_gap_chart.title: Show Race Gap Chart
show_gap_chart.description: Show a horizontal bar chart visualizing each finisher's time gap from the race winner using team-colored bars

gap_chart_drivers.title: Gap Chart Drivers
gap_chart_drivers.description: Number of drivers to show on the race gap bar chart (3-10)

upcoming.title: Upcoming Race
upcoming.description: Configuration for the next race weekend display

show_session_times.title: Show Session Times
show_session_times.description: Show qualifying and sprint session times in addition to race time

countdown_enabled.title: Countdown Timer
countdown_enabled.description: Show live countdown timer to next session

show_circuit_info.title: Show Circuit Stats Card
show_circuit_info.description: Show a circuit facts card after the upcoming race card: laps, distance, and lap record

qualifying.title: Qualifying Results
qualifying.description: Configuration for most recent qualifying session breakdown

show_q1.title: Show Q1
show_q1.description: Show Q1 results (all 20 drivers, bottom 5 eliminated)

show_q2.title: Show Q2
show_q2.description: Show Q2 results (top 15 drivers, bottom 5 eliminated)

show_q3.title: Show Q3
show_q3.description: Show Q3 results (top 10 drivers, determines pole position)

show_gaps.title: Show Gaps
show_gaps.description: Show time differential to session leader

show_team_duel.title: Show Team H2H Card
show_team_duel.description: Show a summary card at the start of qualifying with each team's intra-team battle (which driver outqualified their teammate and by how many positions)

practice.title: Free Practice Results
practice.description: Configuration for free practice session standings

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show free practice results display mode

sessions_to_show.title: Sessions to Show
sessions_to_show.description: Which free practice sessions to display

top_n.title: Top Drivers
top_n.description: Number of top drivers to show per practice session

sprint.title: Sprint Race Results
sprint.description: Configuration for sprint race results (not all race weekends have sprints)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show sprint race results display mode

top_finishers.title: Top Finishers
top_finishers.description: Number of top finishers to display

calendar.title: Race Calendar
calendar.description: Configuration for upcoming race schedule display

max_events.title: Max Events
max_events.description: Maximum number of upcoming race weekends to show

vegas.title: Vegas Marquee
vegas.description: What F1 contributes to the Vegas continuous-scroll marquee. Does not affect the plugin's own display modes, which still show everything.

sections.title: Marquee Sections
sections.description: Which sections join the marquee, in the order listed. A live Grand Prix is prepended automatically when OpenF1 has a fresh snapshot, and last_race is suppressed while that is showing — you do not need to add live_race by hand. Default is the next race and the last race's results. Adding more makes F1 hold the marquee for longer. Leave empty to keep finished/upcoming F1 out of the marquee; a live race still joins.

live.title: Live Race Timing
live.description: Live timing for the race, and optionally practice and qualifying. The source is F1's own timing feed by default: OpenF1 turns unauthenticated clients away while a session is running (found 2026-09-11). Replay pins a finished OpenF1 session so the live cards can be tested without a Grand Prix. fixture_dir is only used with replay — leftover fixtures must not freeze the board on a finished race.

source.title: Live Timing Source
source.description: f1: F1's own live timing feed, free. openf1: the OpenF1 API, which now needs a paid key while a session is running. Replay always uses OpenF1.

session_types.title: Live Sessions
session_types.description: Which live sessions get live cards. Race covers the Grand Prix and the sprint. Practice and qualifying show the order by best lap: the time to beat, then each driver's gap to it.

result_sessions.title: Session Results
result_sessions.description: Finished sessions whose final order stays on the ticker, drawn like the qualifying cards, until the next session goes live. From F1's own feed. Race results come from the last race section instead. An empty list turns this off.

poll_interval.title: Poll Interval
poll_interval.description: Seconds between live snapshots on the plugin update tick. Rendering never waits on HTTP.

replay_session_key.title: Replay Session Key
replay_session_key.description: OpenF1 session_key to replay (Monza 2026 race is 11361). Null in production.

replay_at.title: Replay At
replay_at.description: ISO timestamp inside the replayed session, e.g. 2026-09-06T14:00:00+00:00.

fixture_dir.title: Fixture Directory
fixture_dir.description: Directory of OpenF1 JSON dumps used only when replay_session_key is set.

race_gap.title: Race Gap
race_gap.description: What the live race rows show after P1: interval is each car's time to the car ahead, as the TV timing tower shows it; leader is the gap to the leader.

cars.title: Cars on the Live Board
cars.description: How many cars the live board shows, from the front: 10 is the top ten, 22 the whole 2026 field. The favourite driver is added when outside them. More cars make the F1 block longer in the scroll.

dynamic_duration.title: Dynamic Duration
dynamic_duration.description: Allow scrolling modes to run until their scroll cycle completes instead of using a fixed timer

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for scrolling display modes

max_duration_seconds.title: Max Duration
max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum seconds before forcing rotation even if scroll is incomplete

game_card_width.title: Card Width
game_card_width.description: Width of each card in scroll mode (pixels). Default 128. Set lower on multi-panel chains to show more cards simultaneously.

scroll_speed.title: Scroll Speed
scroll_speed.description: Pixels per frame to scroll (frame-based mode)

scroll_delay.title: Scroll Delay
scroll_delay.description: Delay between scroll frames in seconds

visual.title: Visual Features
visual.description: Enable or disable individual visual elements and set their colors

fastest_lap_dot.title: Fastest Lap Dot
fastest_lap_dot.description: Small colored dot shown on the driver who set the fastest lap in a race result

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show a dot on the driver with the fastest lap

color.title: Color (RGB)
color.description: RGB color of the fastest lap dot (default: purple [180, 0, 255])

gap_bar.title: Championship Gap Bar
gap_bar.description: Horizontal bar showing championship points gap to leader in standings

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the points gap bar in driver and constructor standings

standings_header.title: Standings Header Card
standings_header.description: Intro card shown before driver and constructor standings with F1 logo and season progress

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the standings header card before scrolling through standings

show_round.title: Show Round Info
show_round.description: Show current round number and season progress bar on the header card

circuit_map.title: Circuit Map
circuit_map.description: Circuit layout image shown on the upcoming race card

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show circuit layout diagram on the upcoming race card

championship_leaders.title: Championship Leaders Card
championship_leaders.description: Split card showing current driver and constructor championship leaders at the start of the scroll

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the championship leaders intro card in the scroll sequence

championship_battle.title: Driver Championship Battle Card
championship_battle.description: Split card showing P1 vs P2 driver title fight with gap bar and ALIVE/NEAR/WON status

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the driver championship battle card in the scroll sequence

constructor_battle.title: Constructor Championship Battle Card
constructor_battle.description: Split card showing P1 vs P2 constructor title fight with team logos, gap bar, and ALIVE/NEAR/WON status

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the constructor championship battle card in the scroll sequence

driver_form.title: Driver Form Guide Card
driver_form.description: Compact 2-column grid showing recent race positions per driver as colored boxes (gold=P1, silver=P2, bronze=P3, green=points, red=DNF)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the driver form guide card at the start of the driver standings section

last_race_points.title: Last Race Points Indicator
last_race_points.description: Shows +N points scored in the most recent race on each standings card (gold=podium points, green=solid haul, grey=small haul)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show last-race points (+N) in the stat zone of each driver and constructor standings card

customization.title: Display Customization
customization.description: Customize fonts for different text elements

auto_scale.title: Auto-scale fonts to display size
auto_scale.description: Leave the font fields below blank to auto-pick a crisp pixel (bitmap) font sized for your panel. This toggle only affects a scalable TTF you choose manually: on, it scales that TTF with panel size and snaps it to its pixel grid; off, it uses the exact size below.

header_text.title: Header Text
header_text.description: Font for section headers (GP names, session labels)

position_text.title: Position Numbers
position_text.description: Font for standings position numbers and driver codes

detail_text.title: Detail Text
detail_text.description: Font for points, times, gaps, and other details

small_text.title: Small Text
small_text.description: Font for secondary information (circuit name, location)
